# Question: generator-shortcuts

The strongest plausible shortcut that fits every canonical pair is:

> **Only recolor strictly enclosed objects whose original color is 3.**

All three canonical inputs use color 3 for every object that should inherit a
frame color, so this rival fits 3/3 canonical pairs. It still uses containment
and preserves outside objects, making it more plausible than a global color
replacement.

## Exact generated disagreement

Final generator SHA-256:
`fda9a23aa329d4f01f737dcdf484ca998da3320b3215e1c4f911ca7e2c9c149a`.
The input below was generated at difficulty `easy`, seed `0`, sample index `3`;
the observed profile is `multiple_inside`:

```text
00000000000000
00000044444444
00000048800004
00000040800004
00000040000004
00000040000004
00000040005504
00000040000004
00000044444444
00080000000000
```

The intended rule recolors the enclosed color-8 and color-5 components to frame
color 4 while leaving the outside color-8 singleton unchanged:

```text
00000000000000
00000044444444
00000044400004
00000040400004
00000040000004
00000040000004
00000040004404
00000040000004
00000044444444
00080000000000
```

The color-3-only rival leaves the input unchanged, so the outputs disagree. I
checked the intended output with the generator's Python mirror and with
`arcpuzzles apply` against selected Racket rule hash `372b08419c67`; the results
match exactly. Evidence:
`checks/generator-shortcut-witness/python-evidence.json` and
`checks/generator-shortcut-witness/racket.json`.

## Does the selected generator emit the counterexample family?

Yes. The final source-bound probe sampled 2,400 inputs: 100 seeds × 3 bands × 8
sample indices. Each of the four profiles appeared 600 times. The color-3-only
rival disagreed on 2,205/2,400 inputs, and every declared competitor received a
generated disagreement witness. The probe also checked 1,200 complete
four-demonstration cyclic lessons and found zero where a declared rival fit all
demonstrations but changed the query answer.

The final palette self-review also matters here: profiles no longer encode one
fixed color assignment. The probe observed 134 `multi_cell`, 160 `multiple_inside`, 137
`outside_same_color`, and 134 `two_singletons` distinct frame/inside/outside
role-palette signatures. Full evidence
is in `checks/review-probe-final.json`; the production census independently
materialized 300 lessons (100 per band), found 0 ambiguous, and recorded 1,500
unique inputs in `checks/lesson-census-final.json`.
